touches.text: A device talks to other devices only over the bus, never by importing them.
The bus is the only door, with exceptions (Akien 2026-10-22). Each is a client tool the device publishes:
TESTER MACHINE, CodeMother's (was the tester device, cairn/devices/tester/)
Device name on the command line and bus: inference
Every model call aider makes goes through the inference proxy.
TOOLS: base, chain, bus_client; db client; machine openai_wire (aider speaks OpenAI's wire format; the shim translates it to the inference proxy, per 5.7.3.8)
build_inspector: python sieves run after a build; reds a component that fails one (no charter, no proofs, a silent device, ...). "We find a new thing, we add a new sieve." → CodeMother (10.3.5)
bus_client: gets a process onto the bus (reach a device, or connect).
import_sieve: one parse of every .py into an import graph; what reaches what. Enforces "only the proxy reaches the host/database" and RULE 1. → CodeMother

conflicts.text: Device name on the command line and bus: inference
conflicts.why: Outline 13.3.2 specifies 'Device name on the command line and bus: inference', not 'inference_domain'. The same device cannot have two different bus names; one must be corrected.

open_questions.text: Claude Code itself calls Anthropic directly, around the proxy. Is that "an error" to fix someday (CC's calls routed through it), or is CC outside the rule as an external device?
